name: Staked USDe
who_can_redeem: sUSDe holders may unstake through supported Ethena contracts and interfaces, subject to protocol cooldown and access conditions.
redemption_region_notes: Front-end, jurisdictional, sanctions-screening, and protocol conditions may restrict access.
redemption_notes: sUSDe is a reward-accruing receipt over deposited USDe. It is not a separate fiat redemption claim and its USDe conversion value changes over time.
summary: Ethena's transferable reward-accruing token vault receipt obtained by staking USDe; its USDe-denominated conversion value increases as protocol rewards accrue.
notes: Batch H boundary promotion as a yield-bearing stable receipt, linked to USDe through Registry v3.

name: Savings DAI
who_can_redeem: sDAI holders may use the deployed savings vault contracts to withdraw DAI where supported interfaces and contract routes remain available.
redemption_region_notes: Sky now prioritizes USDS and sUSDS. Access to legacy sDAI routes may depend on direct contract use or third-party interfaces.
redemption_notes: sDAI remains a distinct yield-bearing DAI vault share. It is not exchangeable one-for-one with sUSDS because their accumulated exchange rates differ.
summary: Legacy yield-bearing DAI savings vault share from the Maker/Sky protocol, retained with limited status after sUSDS became the current savings product.
notes: Batch H promotion with conservative limited status; no termination is asserted.

name: Savings USDS
who_can_redeem: Users may deposit USDS for sUSDS and withdraw USDS through the ERC-4626 vault interface, subject to supported interfaces and applicable restrictions.
redemption_region_notes: Front-end screening and jurisdictional restrictions may apply even when contracts remain permissionless.
redemption_notes: sUSDS represents shares in the Sky Savings Rate vault. Its USDS conversion value changes as savings accrue.
summary: Sky Protocol's active ERC-4626 savings wrapper for USDS, providing a transferable share whose USDS conversion value reflects the Sky Savings Rate.
notes: Batch H boundary promotion as a yield-bearing stable receipt.

name: Ondo US Dollar Yield
who_can_redeem: Qualifying onboarded non-US investors may subscribe and redeem under Ondo offering terms; secondary holders may transfer subject to token and jurisdiction restrictions.
redemption_region_notes: Not offered to US persons; additional professional-investor and jurisdiction restrictions apply.
redemption_notes: USDY is a tokenized secured note rather than a traditional stablecoin. Its per-token redemption value generally increases as yield accrues; rUSDY is the separate rebasing representation.
summary: Ondo tokenized secured note backed by short-term U.S. government assets and bank deposits, designed to provide dollar-denominated yield to eligible non-US investors.
notes: Batch H boundary promotion as a stable-value tokenized note, not a fiat stablecoin. Launch-date Batch O uses Ondo’s official introduction dated 2023-09-07; later chain launches remain deployment events.

name: Hashnote US Yield Coin
who_can_redeem: Eligible onboarded non-US institutional investors may subscribe and redeem USYC against USDC through supported teller contracts.
redemption_region_notes: Available only to eligible non-US persons and institutions after KYC/AML and wallet allowlisting; additional restrictions apply.
redemption_notes: USYC represents a share of the Hashnote International Short Duration Yield Fund. It is not a stablecoin liability and its token price increases with fund returns.
summary: Tokenized representation of a Cayman Islands short-duration money market fund, issued and administered by Circle International Bermuda for eligible non-US institutions.
notes: Batch H boundary promotion as a tokenized fund share, not a traditional stablecoin.
